# @three-ws/solana-memo-media-mcp

> Extract, validate, and display image data URIs embedded in Solana SPL Memo instructions. Read-only, local decoding, no key required.

@three-ws/solana-memo-media-mcp is a Model Context Protocol server from three.ws. Install: `npx -y @three-ws/solana-memo-media-mcp`.

## Docs

- [README](https://github.com/nirholas/solana-memo-media-mcp/blob/main/README.md): install, configuration, full reference
- [Documentation site](https://nirholas.github.io/solana-memo-media-mcp/): the README as a web page
- [Full text for LLMs](https://nirholas.github.io/solana-memo-media-mcp/llms-full.txt): README inlined
- [AGENTS.md](https://github.com/nirholas/solana-memo-media-mcp/blob/main/AGENTS.md): guidance for coding agents
